_comment_hooks: Attach the shared catalog at .claude-shared and keep it up to date, and fail loudly if the .claude/ symlinks into it are broken (e.g. a checkout without core.symlinks / Windows Developer Mode). The hook is this repo's copy of the catalog's copy-into-consuming-repository hook; see .claude-shared/README.md. Then, in a linked worktree, link venv to the main checkout's and check out the stub-generator, which the Definition of Done needs: see the hook's own comments.
